query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_festas,
  SUM(valorTotal)/100 as faturamento_reais,
  AVG(valorTotal)/100 as ticket_medio,
  MIN(valorTotal)/100 as menor_valor,
  MAX(valorTotal)/100 as maior_valor
FROM festas
WHERE YEAR(dataFesta) = 2025;
